“𝐍𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐠𝐢𝐚. 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐭’𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮’𝐫𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞. 𝐘𝐨𝐮’𝐫𝐞 𝐚 𝐭𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡.”⁣
⁣
Twenty years after Trainspotting (1996), Mark Renton returns to Edinburgh, only to discover that the world has moved on without him. His old friends are still there, but the lives they once shared are long gone. And no matter how hard they try, none of them can bring those days back. They revisit old places, listen to the same songs, reconnect with people they haven’t seen in years, hoping to feel something they once felt. But the truth is, they’re not really looking for those places or people. They’re looking for the versions of themselves that existed back then. And that’s the cruel thing about growing older. You can return to the same streets, sit in the same pubs, laugh with the same friends, but you’ll never be the same person who experienced those moments for the first time.⁣
⁣
T2 understands this perfectly: nostalgia isn’t a person, place, or even a particular moment. It’s who we used to be.
